messages:
Alex Kim: Planning a global office hours (APAC-friendly). Need recording consent + clip pipeline. Quick sync?

Priya Shah: Legal: public reuse needs explicit speaker release; internal clips OK. Add checkbox in invite and GDPR line on reg page.

Marco Ruiz: Ops: enable Zoom cloud recording + transcript, host-only recording, disable local. Will create a meeting template.

Jenna Lee: Production needs auto-export VTT/SRT and auto 30s/60s clip renders. I can build the Lambda clipper if infra provides bucket+role.

Omar Patel: I'll provision s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2027-01-14-global-officehours and create IAM role. Suggest naming: {utc}_{speaker}_{30s|60s}.mp4 and a metadata CSV.

Lina Torres: Lead routing: HubSpot rule -> if replay_watch_pct >= 50% and domain != @redwood.com then set MQL. UTM schema for clip attribution: utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=clip&utm_campaign=officehours_20270114&utm_content={variant}.

Alex Kim: Checklist: speaker checkbox (Priya), Zoom template (Marco), S3+IAM (Omar), lambda clipper (Jenna), UTM + HubSpot rule (Lina), EU privacy copy (Priya). Proceed?

Priya Shah: I'll add checkbox copy and registration line today.

Marco Ruiz: Template done and posted in #eng-infra.

Omar Patel: Bucket and role live. DM'ed Jenna.

Jenna Lee: Will deploy Lambda tomorrow and share runbook.

Zoom Bot: Recording processed to s3://redwood-assets/webinars/2027-01-14-global-officehours/full_recording.mp4; transcript at full_transcript.vtt
